sn35.132:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno Avantīsu viharati Makkarakaṭe araññe kuṭikāyaṃ || || 2
sn35.132:1.2: Atha kho Lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakā yenāyasmato Mahā-Kaccānassa araññakuṭikā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā parito parito kuṭikāyam anucaṅkamanti anuvicaranti uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kānici kānici selissakāni karonti || ||
sn35.132:1.3: Ime pana muṇḍakā samaṇaka ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā imesam bhāratakānaṃ sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā apacitāti || || 3
sn35.132:1.4: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno vihārā nikkhamitvā te māṇavake etad avoca || ||
sn35.132:1.7: Evam vutte te māṇavakā tuṇhi ahesuṃ || || 4
sn35.132:1.8: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno te māṇavake gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn35.132:3.1: Dhamme ca jhāne ca ratā ahesuṃ ||
sn35.132:8.1: Atha kho te māṇavakā kupitā anattamanā yena Lohicco brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Lohiccam brāhmaṇam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn35.132:8.2: Yagghe bhavaṃ jāneyya samaṇo Mahā-Kaccāno brāhmaṇānam mante ekaṃsena apavadati paṭikkosatīti || ||
sn35.132:8.3: Evaṃ vutte Lohicco brāhmaṇo kupito ahosi anattamano || || 6
sn35.132:8.4: Atha kho Lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi || ||
sn35.132:8.5: Na kho pana me tam patirūpaṃ yo ham aññadatthu māṇavakānaṃ yeva sutvā samaṇam Mahā-Kaccānam akkoseyyaṃ paribhāseyyaṃ ||
sn35.132:9.1: Atha kho Lohicco brāhmaṇo tehi mānavakehi saddhiṃ yenāyasmā Maha-Kaccāno tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Mahā-Kaccanena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn35.132:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārānīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Lohicco brāhmaṇo āyasmantam Mahā-Kaccānam etad avoca || ||
sn35.132:9.3: Āgamaṃsu nu khvidha bho Kaccāna amhākaṃ sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakā ti || ||
sn35.132:9.4: Āgamaṃsu khvidha te brāhmaṇa sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhaharakā māṇavakā ti || ||
sn35.132:9.5: Ahu pana bhoto Kaccānassa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ kocid eva kathāsallāpoti || ||
sn35.132:9.6: Ahu kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ kocid eva kathāsallāpo ti || ||
sn35.132:9.7: Yathā katham pana bhoto Kaccānassa tehi mānavakehi saddhim ahosi kathāsallāpoti || ||
sn35.132:9.8: Evaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhim ahosi kathāsallāpo || ||
sn35.132:11.1: Evaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhim ahosi kathāsallāpoti || || 9
sn35.132:12.2: Kittāvatā nu kho Kaccāna aguttadvāro hotīti || || 10
sn35.132:12.3: Idha brāhmaṇa ekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati || appiyarūpe vyāpajjati || anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā ca viharati parittacetaso ||
sn35.132:12.4: tañ ca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttim yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti || yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā na nirujjhanti || || 11-14
sn35.132:12.9: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati || appiyarūpe dhamme vyāpajjati || anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā ca viharati parittacetaso ||
sn35.132:12.10: tañca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti || yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā na nirujjhanti || || 16
sn35.132:12.12: Acchariyam bho Kaccāna abbhutam bho Kaccāna
sn35.132:12.13: yāvañcidaṃ bhotā Kaccānena aguttadvāro va samāno aguttadvāro ti akkhāto || ||
sn35.132:13.1: Guttadvāro guttadvāro ti bhavaṃ Kaccāno āha ||
sn35.132:13.2: kittāvatā nu kho bho Kaccāna guttadvāro hotīti || || 18
sn35.132:13.3: Idha brāhmaṇa bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati || apiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati || upaṭṭhitāya satiyā ca viharati appamāṇacetaso ||
sn35.132:13.4: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtam pajānāti || yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || || 19-22
sn35.132:13.9: Manasā dhammam viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati || appiyarūpe na vyāpajjati || upaṭṭhitāya satiyā ca viharati appamāṇacetaso ||
sn35.132:13.10: tañ cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtam pajānāti || yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || || 24
sn35.132:14.1: Acchariyaṃ bho Kaccāna abbhutam bho Kaccāna
sn35.132:14.2: yāvañcidam bhotā Kaccānena guttadvāro ca samāno guttadvāro akkhāto || ||
sn35.132:14.3: Abhikkantam bho Kaccāna abhikkantam bho Kaccāna
sn35.132:14.4: seyyathāpi bho Kaccāna nikujjitam vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggam ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti || evam eva bhotā Kaccānena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito || ||
sn35.132:14.5: Esāham bho Kaccāna tam Bhagavantam saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañca ||
sn35.132:14.6: Upāsakam mam bhavam Kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ || ||
sn35.132:14.7: Yathā ca bhavaṃ Kaccāno Makkarakaṭe upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati || evam evaṃ Lohiccakulam upasaṅkamatu ||
sn35.132:14.8: tattha ye māṇavakā vā māṇavikā vā bhavantaṃ Kaccānam abhivādessanti paccupaṭṭhissanti āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā dassanti tesaṃ tam bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti || || 1
